mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 50 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Finance Department has released the 2027 proposed budget for public review. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to meet on November 4th to discuss various development projects, including the Ardent Glen third addition and new site plans for Milky Way.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow features Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, Wednesday has pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee plus trivia at the Bogey Factory, followed by the Main Street Trick or Treat and Art House 360 this Thursday.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I following a report of dangerous driving; no injuries were reported.
Today's delicious flavor is Pumpkin Pecan. The restaurant is currently closed but will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
